headline: Oil Prices Rebound Following Midweek Decline
summary: Brent crude and West Texas Intermediate prices surged on Thursday, recovering from significant losses earlier in the week. Traders are reassessing the potential impact of U.S. election results on the ongoing conflict in Iran.
why: Oil prices are highly sensitive to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and shifts in U.S. foreign policy, which can impact global supply chains and production levels.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Market sentiment shifted following U.S. election developments regarding the Iran conflict.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The rebound was driven by market participants re-evaluating the geopolitical implications of U.S. election outcomes on the Iran conflict, leading to a recovery in energy demand expectations.
